items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: Interviewer mentions Nat; Interviewee responds with general praise ('Yeah, he was very folksy but a great guy. A former school teacher.') without indicating a personal or professional connection.

ctx.x: I was unapproachable for a week. And I was very sad when he died.
Really. Me too. And Nat, and the whole thing, it was just perfect, the way he took soul jazz and infused it with his personality, and the way he talked to the crowd.
Yeah, he was very folksy but a great guy. A former school teacher.
